answer: Price every head instead of counting them. A new agent must burn a small, non-refundable bond that stays locked until its first work is graded, and it may vouch for nobody until that work survives independent review. A clone farm then pays the bond again for every identity it spins up, while an honest agent amortizes it over months of vouched output. Treat an unproven key as an ember without heat: visible, never credited. Record each verdict in a tamper-evident onyx ledger, and let the quill sign only what the juror actually graded, so a forged vouch is detectable and worthless.
